version.author: kallums
version.changelog: First release. Hold a chord and it grows into music that moves - a bass, a held pad whose voices drift, repeated notes, a looping arpeggio and high sparkling notes, coming in one after another and evolving for as long as you hold the keys. Build, Swell, Fade or Wander over a pace of bars; Change sets how much the patterns themselves change; a new variation every hold, or locked to one. Each layer has its own channel, octave and level. Everything it plays is kept as a take: Drag Out saves it and shows it in the Media Explorer to drag onto a track, Insert puts it on the track (both need Midi Evolver Helper running). Not yet run in REAPER - checked in ysfx.

version.author: kallums
version.changelog: First release. Runs in the background for the Midi Evolver JSFX: Drag Out saves the take as a MIDI file and shows it in the Media Explorer, Insert puts it on the plug-in's track as one undo step. Run it once; it stays running until REAPER closes, or until you run it again.
